meta.name: dependency-direction-ports-adapters
meta.description: Introduce ports and adapters with clear dependency direction so domain logic stays isolated from integrations. Use during architecture refactor or new subsystem design.

copy.tagline: 用端口适配器模式隔离领域逻辑与集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构架构或设计新子系统，需要保持领域层纯净。
copy.tagline_en: Isolate domain logic from integrations with ports and adapters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring architecture or designing a new subsystem to keep domain layer clean.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你设计端口（接口）和适配器（实现），确保领域逻辑不依赖外部集成，让替换集成变得容易。
howto.when: 当你进行架构重构或设计新子系统，需要保持领域逻辑纯净时触发。

say.text: 帮我为订单模块设计端口和适配器。
say.note: Claude 会输出接口列表和实现列表。

say.text: 检查当前代码中领域模块是否直接引用了适配器。
say.note: Claude 会验证并报告违规引用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design ports (interfaces) and adapters (implementations) so domain logic stays independent of integrations, making replacements easy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are doing architecture refactoring or designing a new subsystem, and need to keep domain logic pure.

say_en.text: Design ports and adapters for the order module.
say_en.note: Claude will output interface and implementation lists.

say_en.text: Check if domain modules directly reference adapters in the code.
say_en.note: Claude will verify and report violations.
